decision.explanation: All five positions are directly supported by the original sources. Document D1S2 and D1S8 support 'desservant' and 'member of the Council of State', respectively. Document D2S2 confirms 'member of the Chamber of Peers'. Document D2S10 supports both 'Prefect of the Seine-et-Oise department' and 'member of the Council of State'. Document D2S5 supports 'deputy to the National Convention'. These roles are distinct and non-conflicting, representing different periods in Sainte-Hermine’s career.
